theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: SMH-proxy leader ranks #1 with eligibility true and a trend-gate that is validated as risk control on this market. I lean OVERWEIGHT only because the absolute-trend leg is the one validated edge (drawdown/shake-out avoidance) and this theme is above its durability/trend gate — NOT because of its momentum rank. Crowding (z=1.47, crowded=true) and broad breadth=0.0 (a single-name story, r10 only 0.10) tell me this is a thin, attention-driven leadership that warrants a size-down, not a conviction allocation.
evidence: rank 1, score 3.675, eligible true (absolute-trend gate clear)
gate_helps true — trend discipline is the validated drawdown-control leg on US history
crowded true (crowding_z 1.47) and breadth 0.0 — concentration, not cohesion
one_narrative false, absorption 0.32 — no reflexive broad regime behind the leader
theses.dissent: The leader is a crowded, breadth-less single-name story (HBM/memory) whose rank is a focus lens with ~0 forward edge; fading-lagging names or chasing a crowded top historically ends badly, and momentum rank-IC is insignificant on clean US sectors.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 5% over the next 21 trading days

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: GDX ranks #4, is eligible (above its trend gate; durability_bar 0.76 is the highest of any ranked theme), has hurst_tag 'trend' (not mean-revert), the strongest internal breadth of any theme (0.917), and is NOT crowded (z=0.33). This is the cleanest trend-health profile in the entire set: a real, broad, non-crowded trend. The momentum score is modest, so this is a trend-gate + breadth call, not a momentum call.
evidence: eligible true, durability_bar 0.76 (highest in ranks), hurst_tag 'trend'
breadth 0.917 — broad participation, unlike the #1 leader's 0.0
theses.dissent: Mining equities are high-beta to precious metals and the macro backdrop is dominated by ai_tech/geopolitics headlines; if rate/inflation expectations shift or a geopolitical de-escalation hits the gold bid, GDX long-duration real-asset exposure reverses sharply, and the detector has no validated forward return edge.

falsifier.text: GDX underperforms the S&P 500 by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: SIL ranks #2, is eligible (trend-gate clear), has a decent durability_bar of 0.66, breadth 0.75 (broad participation), and is not crowded (z=0.68). Same logic as gold but with slightly better momentum and slightly worse trend-health tag (mixed vs trend). I lean overweight on the trend-gate and breadth legs, acknowledging this is a vol-heavy miner thesis.
evidence: hurst_tag mixed (not mean-revert) — trend intact but less clean than gold
theses.dissent: Silver miners embed extreme equity beta to silver spot plus operational leverage; silver is more industrial-cycle-sensitive than gold, so a growth slowdown or strong-dollar move hits SIL harder and the benchmark proxy is illiquid and gappy, making the directional read noisier.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms GDX by more than 4% over the next 30 trading days without a precious-metals spot selloff
